phases: price preparation + native planner (including full plan materialization)
appropriate managed safety/optimality checker on that plan
actual shared ReplayPolicy complete decoded-input path

protocol_details.raw_values: not repeated: every timed execution is compared outside timers with the complete functional vector, and its full certificate/counts/sink
protocol_details.retention: all four individual calls, zero ticks and slowdowns; no outlier filter, chosen seed, fitted price, automatic repeats or forced GC
protocol_details.interpretation: synthetic sequential CPU buffer; not GPU attention, deployment or a serving-population estimate
